_note: One entry per clip the site plays, and every clip the site plays must be here (build.py stops otherwise). Each entry builds a watch page at /video/<slug>/, the page whose main content is that one video, which is the only kind of page Google indexes a video from (Search Console, 2026-09-25: all 36 detected videos 'not on a watch page', none indexed). `id` is the YouTube id and the embed is the youtube-nocookie player; `file` is a site-relative mp4 with its `poster`. The name is the search term the clip answers, the same as the VideoObject text the act and occasion pages already publish, and the slug is the URL: change a name freely, never a slug without a redirect. `act` is which act the page books.
